QuestInfo.name: [Visitors] Regarding the Primacy
QuestInfo.0: #bGob#k checks your body's data and comes to some conclusion. Hear him out.
QuestInfo.1: Gob warns you that he's not sure what will become of you if you keep absorbing the power of the ancient gods. On another note, it seems like Gob knows something about #bthe Primacy#k. Just who are they?
QuestInfo.2: Gob explained that the Primacy is a militia he cooperated with to stand against #rGerand Darmoor#k. However, you're left with more questions than answers. Maybe Kelly can clear things up.
